title: Clandestine Christian ex-special-forces group approaches the congressman

tellings.quote: they kind of bumped me is the best way to describe it in Washington DC with a at a different meeting.

plain: A secretive group of Christian former special-forces soldiers once sought out a sitting member of Congress in Washington, DC, according to the congressman himself, Eric Burlison. He tells Michels he took part in it: the group, as he puts it, "kind of bumped me" while he was at a different meeting in the city, some time between 2024 and 2026. He tells it as one of the ways people with hidden knowledge of the UFO subject have tried to reach lawmakers.
